comments.body:
Hi @pcbeingused333, thanks for looking into this! We're going to close this one and take a look at #910 ourselves.

Returning errors from `applyResources` is the right idea, but skipping a Job that already exists means Kratix can record an old Job's result as the current run's, which is the #910 incident without the error log. The real fix needs to stop Job names clashing in the first place, and that touches how we name and track Jobs, so we may do a bigger refactor of this area rather than a targeted fix.

Appreciate the contribution.
